name: Phoenecia
source:
The Third Empress of the Realm, Phoenecia is originally a foreign princess from a vassal state.

Her beauty and penchant for gossip are matched only by her ambitions to be at the center of every major power in the Empire, an ambition she actively cultivates in her son, Lucion.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/teamgalens/status/1668302145056124930]Twitter[/url]]
